name: codex-flat-rate
description: Codex usage is covered by a flat-rate plan, so it should not add dollars on top. Models that the plan does not cover are marked unpriced on purpose instead of silently falling back to list prices.

gpt-5.6.note: covered by the flat-rate Codex plan

gpt-5.6-terra.note: covered by the flat-rate Codex plan

gpt-6*.note: not included in the flat-rate plan; keep it out of dollar totals
